Link: https://github.com/re-cinq/Otto/pull/439

## Why

When the tool budget runs out the customer got no answer at all, and nobody on the OLT side heard about it. The support agent has to say so in Danish and hand the question to a human instead of going silent (#151).

## What Changed

`createBudgetHooks` detects an exhausted tool budget, sends the customer a fixed Danish message and records one `tool_budget_exhausted` escalation. It joins the hook chain after escalation and before the prompt (FR-025), and the escalation trigger list and recorder…

# Support agent escalation

## Requirements

### Functional Requirements

- **FR-019**: The fragment MUST call `escalationRecorder.mark(session.sessionId, 'tool_budget_exhausted')` exactly once before returning `TOOL_BUDGET_MESSAGE_DA`. (#151) ([validated by `marks tool_budget_exhausted once and returns TOOL_BUDGET_MESSAGE_DA`](../../apps/api/test/budgetHooks.test.ts#L19))
- **FR-020**: The string MUST render in the assistant's own bubble through the normal `entry_upsert` → `entry_delta` → `entry_commit` text path, not through `support-agent-danish-failure-messages` (#48)'s catalogue. It is written in the first person, the opposite of that catalogue's impersonal wording. (#151) ([validated by `tells the customer in Danish and records an escalation when the budget runs out`](../../apps/api/…

## Tech notes

Build with `/lore-feature "Tell the OLT customer in Danish when the tool budget runs out"` - spec lands at `specs/support-agent-tool-budget-message/spec.md`, tasks at `tasks.md`, description via `/lore-pr`.

Not in scope: the engine-side signal (`094`'s hook and `093`'s gate), notifying a human (`096`, blocked on `KU-14` - this issue only writes a row through `054`'s sink), installing `115`'s `beforeToolCall` through the composer (declined by `116`), raising or lowering `MAX_TOOL_ROUNDS` (`049` owns it, default 5, clamped 1-20), an audit record for the exhaustion (`065` already fires normally), an eval fixture for a looping model (`055`'s harness has none), and any `apps/web` or `bowman-ui` change.

# Support agent escalation

## User Scenarios & Testing

### User Story 3 - The customer is told when the tool budget runs out (Priority: P1, #151)

A customer asks a question that makes the model keep requesting tools until the budget runs out. Instead of an empty bubble, the assistant replies with one Danish sentence that promises nothing it cannot keep, and an escalation is recorded. A broken hook fragment on this path does not break the turn.

**Why this priority:** An empty reply is the worst outcome for a support channel, and this is the only turn ending with no owner.

**Independent Test:** Run the engine with `maxToolRounds: 2` and a stub that always requests tools. Assert one escalation document containing `tool_budget_exhausted` and the sentence in the committed assistant entry. …

## Why
